elements.title: Figure 6.—Value of Other Industrial Minerals Produced in 2023, by Region
elements.content:
Map of the United States divided into four regions: West, Midwest, Northeast, South. Each state is labeled with abbreviations of industrial minerals produced there. Color-coded by value in billion dollars: 1.7 (lightest), 8.4, 9.5, 15.1 (darkest). West states mostly in orange shades, Midwest in lighter orange, Northeast in lightest shade, South in darkest red.

Legend for minerals abbreviations:
B - Borates
Bar - Barite
BC - Ball clay
Bent - Bentonite
Br - Bromine
Bx - Bauxite
CaF2 - Fluorspar
Clay - Common clay
Dia - Diatomite
DS - Dimension stone
FC - Fire clay
Fel - Feldspar
Ful - Fuller's earth
Gar - Garnet
Gyp - Gypsum
He - Helium
I - Iodine
IOP - Iron oxide pigments
IS - Industrial sand
K - Potash
Kao - Kaolin
Kya - Kyanite
Li - Lithium
MgCp - Magnesium compounds
Mica - Mica
NaC - Soda ash
P - Phosphate rock
Peat - Peat
Per - Perlite
Pum - Pumice
Pyrp - Pyrophyllite
Salt - Salt
Talc - Talc
Wol - Wollastonite
Zeo - Zeolites

Explanation of value colors:
1.7 billion dollars (lightest)
8.4 billion dollars
9.5 billion dollars
15.1 billion dollars (darkest)
